releases.title: Navigation hotfix
changes: Fix undefined mobile navigation icon and replace the old Profile tab with Settings.

releases.title: Next episode handoff and Anime/Manga navigation
changes: Prepare upcoming video and show a three-second countdown after readiness; suggest other anime after a finished series.
Keep source information in audio and server settings.
One animated hover preview at a time with intentional-hover delay.
Top-right profile and notification inbox with tracked releases and website updates.
Anime/Manga switcher and a dedicated manga catalogue, search, reading list and local CBZ reader.

releases.title: Navigation, hover and calendar fixes
changes: Dedicated ranked sections with heading arrows instead of inline expansion.
Seven-day unique recent releases with broader family-cartoon filtering.
Viewport-safe hover cards, visible list controls and five-second trailer delay.
Boundary-aware carousel arrows and clickable original PNG-derived AniDash branding.
Monthly release calendar with date selection and AM/PM times.

releases.title: Settings tabs, smarter discovery and playback handoff
changes: Separate settings tabs, contextual two-second notices and expandable paired device details.
Automatic web update notices outside active playback, and a dedicated developer and sponsorship section.
Continue Watching episode links across anime cards, shared episode metadata prefetch and clearer view icons.
Expandable trending and daily release rankings, same-day deduplication, and selected cartoon franchise filters.
Larger trailer previews with sound controls and browser-local custom lists.

releases.title: Settings, release information and site transparency
changes: Responsive settings layout and clearer account connection states.
Ordered website playback updates and tracker confirmation.
Public About, Releases, Support, Privacy and Terms pages.
Website version checking, sitemap and discoverability metadata.
